desc:
A liminal space horror game that gets more difficult as it continues. Infinite lives, infinite possibilities.

This game is inspired by The Backrooms and Liminal Spaces!

You play as a group of teenagers sneaking into a building and realizing things aren't quite as they should be...

This is only an alpha!

Tags: Interliminality, Liminal Space, Liminal, Backrooms, Horror, Horror Game, Weirdcore, Story, Liminal Horror
